{{Quote|There's a multitude of those things!''"<br/>"''Kueller sure spent a fortune. Not even the Empire deployed this many at once.|Mara Jade and Han Solo, defending themselves aboard the ''Millenium Falcon'' against TIE fighters|<ref name="Rebellion" />}}
The '''Battle of Almania''' was a battle between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Kueller]]'s warfleet at the [[Almanian system]].

==Background==
Prior to the battle, [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] dispatched [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] in her personal starship on a rescue mission to Almania, accompanied by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] in a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]], the [[Yavin (starship)|''Yavin'']] and several other smaller vessels.<ref name="Rebellion" />

==The battle==
Upon arrival at Almania, they were attacked by three [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], which unleashed swarms of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. While Antilles's fleet engaged them, Leia Organa Solo slipped through the battle in her personal starship and landed on Almania. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet suffered heavy losses during the assault; [[Kueller]], Master of Almania, had counted on them to fight his forces in the same way they did against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rebellion" />

Suddenly, Antilles realized through the oddly precise maneuvers of the Star Destroyers that they were automated. He then ordered his flagship's gunners to open fire on the other New Republic vessels, not enough to cause heavy damage but to persuade the enemy computers that his vessel was one of them. The automated Star Destroyers circled around Antilles's flagship in a protective position, and he disabled them with precise [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] hits.<ref name="Rebellion" />

Here, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] engaged in a duel with Kueller. Luke had been previously injured by Kueller when he touched down on the planet. With the aid of a native animal, a [[thernbee]], Luke escaped Kueller. When Leia came to rescue him, Kueller confronted them, intent on killing them both. Luke attacked, but in his weakened state, Kueller pushed him back, feeding off his anger to become more powerful. Leia fired blaster shots at Kueller, but he deflected them. Skywalker realized that prolonging the duel was only making Kueller stronger and prepared to sacrifice himself as his mentor [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|had done]] and then guide Leia to defeat Kueller. However, at that point, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] arrived with [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamir]], which [[Force suppression|repelled]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Caught in the Force-empty bubble, Kueller was momentarily stunned. Feeling that it was not over yet, he prepared to activate a series of detonator-rigged droids around the galaxy and to draw on the power of the disturbance in the Force that the thousands of deaths caused by the explosions would generate. However, before he could do so, Leia [[Telekinesis/Legends|reached for]] Han's [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|weapon]], fired twice and killed the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="Rebellion" />
